scope: Independent constant/path-only port comparison and 31 fresh offline orchestration fixtures. No implementation edits, real transport, torch/model/native import, GPU/SSH/stage/production binding/lease/state or scientific results.

test_fixture_port.isolation: FixtureAdapter stubs only release-source verification; actual frozen PSBR preparation/schema and all current guard logic execute against disposable copied state. FakeTransport replaces every remote call. Remote-operation tests patch process/NVML/flock entry paths; all request/result/lease files are disposable mock files beneath this new bundle, not production execution artifacts.

covered_boundaries: Exact owning thread/context hash, frozen goal/preparation/native assets and PSBR candidate identity; missing/held candidate or disabled policy/dispatch refuses before transport.

Snapshot/current whitelist consistency, GPU0/1 fixed UUIDs, string/int GPU equivalence, rejection of bool/unknown/missing/outside-whitelist assignment for running/claiming or uncertain reserved launches.
Ordinary waiting/dependency/nonlaunch holds do not occupy physical slots; waiting+pending_progress and canonical launch-uncertain prefixes reserve slots conservatively.
Busy NVML/lock or deadline failure, including deadline exhausted during probe, creates no production execution manifest/lease; only mocked idle success creates disposable fixture bindings.
Owner/context/manifest/lease full binding checks; older owner binding remains read-only inspectable while mutation after owner change is denied and old lease bytes are not refreshed.

Existing request is reconciled rather than replayed; uncertain transport retains exact request and retry performs reconciliation only; successful mocked pair creates exactly four distinct mode/target requests, once each.

Remote read-only reconcile accepts expired prior binding for observation, never writes/starts/renews, and checks exact stage/request/mode/target/commit/package/PID/argv/start_ticks/result identity; foreign PID or reused PID cannot count as original.
Remote timeout records uncertainty without kill/restart; expired mutation and existing remote request refuse before spawning; wrong GPU UUID/stage is rejected.
